## CLI version reporting

- Added `claude-statusblocks --version` and `claude-statusblocks -v` so installed CLI output can be checked directly against npm, the source manifest, and the matching GitHub Release.
- Kept the version value sourced from the packaged `package.json` rather than duplicating it in runtime code.
- Added deterministic coverage for both flags and included the command in built-in help and the README.

This release contains no layout, status-line data, installation-path, or update-policy change.
